```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

library(sirfunctions)
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)

use_cache <- TRUE # Change if creating report using previous run or new run
end_date <- "2025-12-31" # Change as needed. Only works for new runs

if (use_cache) {
  if (!dir.exists("data_cache")) {
    dir.create("data_cache")
  }
  
  if (length(list.files("data_cache")) == 0) {
    cli::cli_alert_warning("No data found in cache. Performing a new run.")
    source("generate_data_for_report.R")
  } else {
    load("data_cache/cache.rda")
  }
} else {
  source("generate_data_for_report.R")
}

tile_plots <- list.files("R/", "_tile_plot.R")
lapply(tile_plots, \(x) source(file.path("R", x)))

```

::: panel-tabset

## Overview

The objective of the monthly SG Monitoring Report is as an early indicator warning
for potential disruption in the surveillance system. Indicators are at the country level. 
It is divided into three sections:

**Tile Plots**

The Tile Plots provide a system-wide view for various AFP, ES, and lab indicators
across a region. It is a way to quickly sift through countries that are below the 
surveillance targets.

**Graphs**

The Graphs tab provides a country-level view for various AFP, ES, and lab indicators. 
It is meant to show trends in indicator performance across a temporal scale.

**Detailed Tables**

The Detailed Tables tab presents the data sources used to create the figures in this report.
They are summary table based on available data obtained from POLIS.

**Notes on Lab Data**

Lab data is updated quarterly, hence end dates may not be the same as the end date used in the report.

## Tile Plots

*Filter only applies to AFP and ES tile plots*

```{=html}
<select id="imageSelector" onchange="showImages();">
  <option value="def">Select a region</option>
  <option value="AFRO">AFRO</option>
  <option value="AMRO">AMRO</option>
  <option value="EMRO">EMRO</option>
  <option value="EURO">EURO</option>
  <option value="SEARO">SEARO</option>
  <option value="WPRO">WPRO</option>
</select>

<script>
  function showImages() {
    var selector = document.getElementById("imageSelector");
    var imageES = document.getElementById("selectedImageES");
    var imageAFP = document.getElementById("selectedImageAFP");
    var selectedValue = selector.value;
    
    var base = "images/";

    // Don't try to load if the default placeholder is selected
    if (selectedValue && selectedValue !== "def") {
      imageES.src  = base + selectedValue + "_es_plot.jpg";
      imageAFP.src = base + selectedValue + "_afp_plot.jpg";
    } else {
      imageES.src  = "";
      imageAFP.src = "";
    }

    imageES.style.display  = imageES.src  ? "block" : "none";
    imageAFP.style.display = imageAFP.src ? "block" : "none";
  }
  
</script>
```

### Number of samples per sites

```{r}
#| label: es-site-samples
#| include: false
#| echo: false


failing_sites <- es_site_samples |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(failing_performance, "Yes \\(")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(ADM0_NAME) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ADM0_NAME))

failing_active_sites <- es_site_samples |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(failing_performance, "Yes \\("),
                active_site == "Yes") |>
  dplyr::group_by(ADM0_NAME) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ADM0_NAME))

es_failure_summary <- paste0(
  "There are ", nrow(failing_sites), " countries with failing sites, ",
  "with a total of ", sum(failing_sites$n, na.rm = TRUE), " sites.",
  " Failing sites are those who have been open for at least 12 months", 
  " with no collections in the last two months or",
  " have less than 10 samples in the past rolling 12-month period. Of the failing sites, ",
  sum(failing_active_sites$n, na.rm = TRUE),
  " are considered active sites (sites with at least 10 collections in the past rolling 12-month period), ",
  "with no EV detection in the past two months."
)

es_site_samples <- es_site_samples |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Country = "ADM0_NAME",
    `Site Name` = "site.name",
    `Site Age` = "site_age",
    `Samples In Last 12 Months` = "n_samples_12_mo",
    `POLIS Site Status` = "site.status",
    `Earliest Collection` = "earliest_collection",
    `Last Collection` = "last_collection",
    `Days Since Last Collection` = "days_since_last_collection",
    `Collection In Two Months` = "collection_two_mo",
    `Last Detection` = "last_detection",
    `Days Since Last Detection` = "days_since_last_det",
    `Detection In Two Months` = "detection_two_mo",
    `Is Active Site` = "active_site",
    `Failing Performance` = "failing_performance"
  )

```

## Lab Surveillance Indicators
`{r} max_date_notif`

::: panel-sidebar
### Timeliness of virus isolation results

```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: false

culture_lab_intervals <- culture_lab_intervals |>
  dplyr::rename_with(recode,
                     culture.itd.lab = "Culture/ITD Lab",
                     comparison = "Difference",
                     prop_diff = "Difference, %",
                     trend = "Trend")

interval_summary <- culture_lab_intervals |> 
    dplyr::filter(interval == "days.lab.culture") |>
    dplyr::select(-interval)
top_10 <- interval_summary |> 
  filter(Trend == "Increase") |> 
  arrange(desc(Difference)) |>
  select(-Trend) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
bottom_10 <-interval_summary |> 
  filter(Trend == "Decrease") |> 
  arrange(Difference) |>
  select(-Trend) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

summary_string_top <- glue::glue_data(
  top_10,
  "{str_to_title(`Culture/ITD Lab`)} ({round(Difference, 1)})"
)
summary_string_bottom <- glue::glue_data(
  bottom_10,
  "{str_to_title(`Culture/ITD Lab`)} ({round(Difference, 1)})"
)

# Combine into a single sentence
final_summary_top <- paste0("The top labs with increased median timeliness compared to the three year median (difference in days shown) are: ", paste(summary_string_top, collapse = ", "), ".")
final_summary_bottom <- paste0("The top 10 labs with the biggest improvement in median timeliness compared to the three year median (difference in days shown) are: ", paste(summary_string_bottom, collapse = ", "), ".")
comparible <- paste("There were", interval_summary |> 
                      filter(Trend == "Same") |> 
                      nrow(), "labss the stayed in the same levels and", 
                    interval_summary |> 
                      filter(Trend == "No data available for both years") |> 
                      nrow(), "labs with missing 3-year medians or 2025 medians.")
overall <- paste0("Overall, ", 
                  interval_summary |> 
                    filter(!is.na(`Culture/ITD Lab`), 
                           Trend != "No data available for both years") |>
                    pull(`Culture/ITD Lab`) |> 
                    unique() |> 
                    length(), " labs had data in the lab dataset. ",
                  interval_summary |>
                    filter(!is.na(`Culture/ITD Lab`)) |>
                    select(4) |> 
                    filter(if_all(1, \(x) !is.na(x))) |>
                    nrow(), " labs had medians for the current year and ",
                  interval_summary |> 
                    filter(!is.na(`Culture/ITD Lab`)) |>
                    select(3) |> 
                    filter(if_all(1, \(x) !is.na(x))) |>
                    nrow(), " labs had 3-year medians."
                  )

```

#### Summary

`r final_summary_top`

`r final_summary_bottom`

`r comparible`

`r overall`

```{r}
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
    pageLength = 10
  )
)
```

### Laboratory workload

```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: false

lab_workload <- lab_workload |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Culture/ITD Lab` = "culture.itd.lab",
    Month = "month",
    `Countries Served` = "from_ctry",
    Difference = "comparison",
    `Difference (%)` = "comparison_pct",
    Trend = "trend"
  )

last_month <- lab_workload |>
  filter(Month == lubridate::month(lubridate::month(max_lab_date) - 1, TRUE))

top_10 <- last_month |>
  filter(Trend == "Increase") |>
  arrange(desc(Difference)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

bottom_10 <- last_month |> 
  filter(Trend == "Decrease") |> 
  arrange(Difference) |>
  select(-Trend) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

summary_string_top <- glue::glue_data(
  top_10,
  "{str_to_title(`Culture/ITD Lab`)} ({round(Difference, 1)})"
)
summary_string_bottom <- glue::glue_data(
  bottom_10,
  "{str_to_title(`Culture/ITD Lab`)} ({round(Difference, 1)})"
)

# Combine into a single sentence
final_summary_top <- paste0("The top 10 labs with increased lab samples compared to the previous year (difference in samples shown) are: ", paste(summary_string_top, collapse = ", "), ".")
final_summary_bottom <- paste0("The top 10 labs with reduced lab samples compared to the previous year (difference in samples shown) are: ", paste(summary_string_bottom, collapse = ", "), ".")
comparible <- paste("There were", last_month |> 
                      filter(Trend == "Same") |> nrow(), "labs the stayed in the same levels and", last_month |> 
                      filter(Trend == "No data available for both years") |> 
                      nrow(), "labs with missing data for the current year and previous year.")
overall <- paste0("Overall, ", 
                  last_month |> 
                    filter(if_any(5, \(x) !is.na(x))) |> 
                    nrow(), 
                  " labs had data from the previous month of the current year using the latest month available in the lab dataset.")

```

#### Summary

**For the previous month from the latest date available in the lab dataset**

`r final_summary_top`
